title: WPMS/989/2008 of SUSHIL KUMAR GARG AND OTHERS Vs SMT. SHAKUNTALA DEVI

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition No. 989 of 2008 (M/S)
Sushil Kumar Garg & others. .......... Petitioners
Versus
Smt. Shakuntala Devi. .......... Respondent
Mr. Sharad Sharma, Advocate for the petitioners.
Hon'ble V.K. Gupta, C.J.

Vide the impugned order dated 4th March, 2008, while issuing
notice to the respondent in the Temporary Injunction Application and
declining to grant ad-interim ex-parte injunction, the learned trial
court had fixed 19th March, 2008 as the next date in the case.
Thereafter, apparently the matter was adjourned on a few occasions
without the respondent being served the notice in the Temporary
Injunction Application matter.
 Without admitting this petition to hearing, I dispose it of at the
motion hearing stage, also without issuing any notice to the
respondent, by passing the following order:
 Within three days from the date of communication of this order,
the learned trial court shall ensure that effective steps are taken for
service of notice in the Temporary Injunction Application matter upon
the respondent. Actually, a special Process Server shall be deputed
for this purpose with explicit directions to him to ensure that all steps
are taken by him for effecting service upon the respondent. A very
short date shall be fixed in the notice which shall be made returnable
before that date. Once the respondent appears, the Temporary
Injunction Application shall be disposed of within four weeks from
the date of her appearance.
 (V.K. Gupta, C. J.)
 17.06.2008
G
